# Aman Gupta

> Aman Gupta leads research on reliable AI agents and efficient foundation models at Nubank for systems serving more than 135 million customers.

Reliable AI agents and efficient foundation models at production scale.

LLM post-training · constrained optimization

I lead AI research at Nubank for systems serving more than 135 million customers, with a focus on evaluation, alignment, and efficient training and inference. Previously, I led ranking foundation-model optimization at LinkedIn.

Published at ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, KDD, WWW, CIKM, and EMNLP.

## Research directions

### Reliable AI agents

How do we know an agent is ready for real customers? I build evaluation systems that connect offline simulation, human judgment, and online experiments so iteration speed does not come at the cost of reliability.

Flagship: Building Customer Support AI Agents at 100M-User Scale: An Evaluation-Driven Framework (KDD 2026). https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.08867

A unified framework for context engineering, prompt optimization, offline evaluation, and production validation across five Nubank deployments; offline metrics tracked online outcomes, and the card-delivery agent improved transactional NPS by 37 percentage points.

Related work:

- [Tutorial @ CIKM 2026] Building Production LLM Agents: An Evaluation-Driven Playbook (half-day tutorial · Nov 2026).
- [Talk @ AI Engineer] SimulationMaxxing: How we ship agents 20× faster (with Shreya Rajpal · Jul 2026). https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KMR_RBoCa4M

### LLM alignment and post-training

How do reward design and evaluation shape model behavior after pretraining? I study where standard preference-optimization recipes become brittle and how to make alignment more controllable.

Flagship: AlphaPO: Reward Shape Matters for LLM Alignment (ICML 2025). https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03884

Introduces an alpha-parameterized reward shape that controls likelihood displacement and over-optimization, improving alignment performance over SimPO and DPO across Mistral-7B and Llama-3-8B.

Related work:

- [ICML 2025] On the Robustness of Reward Models for Language Model Alignment. https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07271

### Efficient foundation models

How do we preserve model quality while meeting real training, latency, and serving budgets? I work across distillation, compression, quantization, and systems-aware inference.

Flagship: Scaling Down, Serving Fast: Compressing and Deploying Efficient LLMs for Recommendation Systems (EMNLP 2025). https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14305

Distills and compresses production language models with structured pruning and quantization, retaining much of larger-model quality while reducing training and serving cost and latency across recommendation workloads.

Related work:

- [SPOT@ICLR 2026] Effective Quantization of Muon Optimizer States. https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23106
- [NeurIPS 2025] LLM Query Scheduling with Prefix Reuse and Latency Constraints. https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.04677
- [Tutorial @ WWW 2025] Efficient Algorithms for Leveraging LLMs for Generative and Predictive Recommender Systems. https://doi.org/10.1145/3701716.3715868

### Constrained optimization at scale

How do we optimize recommendations against global business, allocation, and diversity constraints at web scale? I develop optimization methods that turn model predictions into globally coordinated decisions.

Flagship: Practical Design of Performant Recommender Systems using Large-scale Linear Programming-based Global Inference (Tutorial @ KDD 2023). https://sites.google.com/view/kdd-2023-large-scale-lps

Presents DuaLip, a distributed solver for linear programs with trillions of variables, deployed across LinkedIn recommender systems and released as an extensible open-source library.

Related work:

- [OPT@NeurIPS 2022] A Light-speed Linear Program Solver for Personalized Recommendation with Diversity Constraints. https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12409
- [KDD 2024] LiRank: Industrial Large Scale Ranking Models at LinkedIn. https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.06859
- [CIKM 2024] LiNR: Model Based Neural Retrieval on GPUs at LinkedIn. https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.13218
- [KDD 2022] Generalized Deep Mixed Models. https://doi.org/10.1145/3534678.3539103
